description:
Ron Kamonohashi was once regarded as a genius at the top detective training academy. But after a fatal mistake, he was expelled and forbidden to become a detective. Years later, police officer Totomaru Isshiki knocks on Ron’s door seeking help on a serial murder case. He finds Ron, now a messy-haired recluse, who agrees. Together, this mismatched detective team begins solving their first mystery!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

node.description:
A talented detective and the student with the highest grades in Detective Training Academy BLUE's history. As his detective license was revoked after an incident five years ago, he has partnered up with [Totomaru Isshiki](https://anilist.co/character/193587/) to still be able to solve cases.

~!Later, it is confirmed that Ron Kamonohashi isn't the true culprit behind the Bloody Field Trip, but "Shachi". It was to ruin his detective life.!~

Totomaru Isshiki, frequently shortened to Toto, is a police detective of the Metropolitan Police Department. He helps [Ron Kamonohashi](https://anilist.co/character/191539/) investigate cases by pretending to be the one who solves them.
Mofu Usaki is world-renowned neurosurgeon who does surgeries on a microscopic scale and undertakes at least 800 surgeries a year. She also stars in the liveshow "Lie or Truth? ESP!!"

node.description: Amamiya is the leader of the First Investigative Division of the Metropolitan Police Department and Totomaru Isshiki's superior.

A police detective at the Aichi Prefectural Police and the detective with the highest number of solved cases in the entire country. Because of this, he is already considered for police superintendent general.

A crime reporter at Lime Weekly.

The locked room instructor at BLUE and the world's expert on locked room studies.

She is one of the few people in the world who holds a S-rank detective license. With her "Phoenix touch" ability, she has found 5,000 hidden rooms, 3,000 illegal constructions, and 10,000 tricks of physics so far.
Eme Emmerich is the headmistress of Detective Training Academy BLUE and an old friend of Ron Kamonohashi's parents.
